title: Balochistan Public Service Commission Amendment Act 2004

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Public Service Commission Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 2004
ACT IV OF 2004
BALOCHISTAN PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISISON (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act, further to
amend the Balochistan Public Service Commission Act, 1989
[Gazette of
Balochistan Extraordinary, 13th May, 2004]
No. PAB/Legis: V(15)/2004,
dated 13-5-2004.---The Balochistan Public Service Commission (Amendment)
Bill, 2004 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 7th
May, 2004 and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
It is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Act may be called the Balochistan Public Service
Commission (Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Public Service Commission Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Amendment of Section 3 of Act II of 1989

ACT IV OF 2004
ACT IV OF 2004
BALOCHISTAN PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISISON (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act, further to
amend the Balochistan Public Service Commission Act, 1989
[Gazette of
Balochistan Extraordinary, 13th May, 2004]
No. PAB/Legis: V(15)/2004,
dated 13-5-2004.---The Balochistan Public Service Commission (Amendment)
Bill, 2004 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 7th
May, 2004 and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
It is hereby enacted as follows:
2. Amendment of Section 3 of
Act II of 1989.---In the Balochistan Public Service Commission Act, 1989
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 3:-
(a) In sub
section (3) for the word "Government" the words "Governor, in
consultation with the Chief Minister" shall be substituted.
(b) After
subsection (3), the following proviso, shall be added:-
"Provided that no person
below the age of 55 years shall be, appointed as Chairman or Member of the
Commission".

[Gazette of
Balochistan Extraordinary, 13th May, 2004]
No. PAB/Legis: V(15)/2004,
dated 13-5-2004.---The Balochistan Public Service Commission (Amendment)
Bill, 2004 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 7th
May, 2004 and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
It is hereby enacted as follows:
3. Amendment of Section 4 of
Act II of 1989.---In the said Act, for section 4, the following shall be
substituted:
4. Terms of office of Chairman
and Member.
(1) The term of office of the
Chairman or a Member of the Commission shall be five years:
Provided that a Member who
immediately before his appointment as Member was, holding a post in the service
of Pakistan may be transferred in public interest before the expiry of his term
of office.
(2) The Chairman or a Member may resign
his office by writing under his hand addressed to the Governor.
